body:
Incident lists now page parent records before loading related history, with stable navigation through tied opening times and complete detail history. Three-request local diagnostics show list reads falling from 1,805 / 180,005 to 959 / 959 for 90 / 9,000 incidents; detail remains 1,317 / 1,343.

This continues #366 with the same product code and tests. Migration 0079 is renamed byte-identically to reserved 0080, and RELEASE.json gains only its required inventory entry. No version, release-note or contract judgment changes.

Local release validation, typecheck, incident API, migration setup, identity forward upgrade, technical/native archive restores, previous-release archive restore and a backfill/replay/transition migration probe pass. Browser and exact-SHA Verify are in progress.

Both unchanged main and the candidate exceed the untouched 200 MiB full-fixture guard during generation. Separate incident-query diagnostics retain the original incident counts and expressions while omitting unrelated subscriber and component-state-history populations; they remain below the same guard and are diagnostic evidence, not full-fixture acceptance proof.

Reports and actual receipts are published separately at evidence/sd-lamp-qgrowth-incidents-2. The fleet owns the independent migration gate and complete publication scan before landing.
